title: Partial Dependence by Hand
learning_objectives: Average ICE curves over a dataset to get partial dependence
Centre curves at the first grid point
entry_point: partial_dependence(predict, X, feature, grid); ice_spread(predict, X, feature, grid)
hints: Write `_ice_matrix` returning shape `(n, m)`: for each grid value g, copy X, set column, predict.

failure_feedback.advice: PD averages predictions over instances with the feature fixed at each grid value.
Centre each ICE curve at grid[0], then take the std across instances and average over the grid.
Additive effects give parallel ICE curves, hence zero spread.
Copy X before overwriting the feature column.
